title: app-shell: a refused metadata write on the view, report and draft surfaces is logged only — the view-config panel's edit Save is measured silent (the objectui#11578 family's closing card)
body:
Filing gate: **class (a)**, a product defect with a named landing and a reproduction. `reach:` **public door, measured**: the object page's view-config panel Save in edit mode, mounted with a metadata client whose save rejects with 403. Reader: triage grades and routes it.

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`, seat post objectui#5560). It comes from the objectui#11578 dev's out-of-scope finding (report `5974794723`, PR objectui#11582). This seat re-read every location at objectui `origin/main` `0a53c67`. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Family rule:** objectui#11578 (the two create doors) is the first occurrence of "a refused metadata write is caught with a log line only, and the UI looks saved". This is the second, so this card is the family's **closing card**, with an enumeration pin over every location, rather than one card per site.

## What happens (measured)
Measured by the objectui#11578 dev, with a throwaway probe built on the objectui#10210 wiring harness (not committed): the metadata client's `save` rejects with 403, and the user presses Save in the view-config panel's edit mode.
- `toast.error`: 0 calls. `toast.success`: 0 calls.
- The only trace is `console.error('[ViewConfigPanel] Failed to persist view config:', …)`.
- From source (not mounted): `ViewConfigPanel.handleSave` calls `onSave` without awaiting, then clears `isDirty` and bumps `savedSignal`. Save is disabled while the panel is not dirty in edit mode, so a refused edit looks saved, and the user cannot retry it without making another edit.

## The family, enumerated (read at `0a53c67`)
| # | Location | Write | Catch | Status |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, `handleViewConfigSave` (about `:1495`) | `persistRuntimeMetadata('view', …)` | `.catch` → `console.error('[ViewConfigPanel] Failed to persist view config:')` | **measured** (above) |
| 2 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx`, `handleSave` (about `:192`) | calls row 1 through `onSave` | none: `setIsDirty(false)` runs before the save settles | read from source |
| 3 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, `handlePinView` (about `:2262`) | `dataSource.updateView(…, { isPinned })` | `console.error('[ViewTabBar] Failed to pin view:')`; its rename, delete and set-default siblings toast | read from source |
| 4 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx`, `saveSchema` (about `:177`) | `persistRuntimeMetadata('report', …)` | `console.warn('[ReportView] Auto-save failed:')` | read from source |
| 5 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`, `handlePublish` (about `:127`) | `publishRuntimeMetadata(…)` | `console.error('[RuntimeDraftBar] Publish failed:')` | read from source |
| 6 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`, `handleDiscard` (about `:141`) | `discardRuntimeDraft(…)` | `console.error('[RuntimeDraftBar] Discard draft failed:')` | read from source |

Already fixed, not this card: `ObjectDataPage.handleSaveAsView` and `ObjectView.handleViewCreate` (objectui#11578, PR objectui#11582). Those doors now raise `toast.error(t('form.saveError'), { description: formatMetadataError(err) })` and report the failure to their dialog.

## Likely landing (a lead, not a ruling)
- Each row raises the refusal through the console's existing `toast.error` channel, with the door's message (`formatMetadataError`), the way objectui#11578's doors do. ⛔ No new notification surface.
- Row 2: the panel clears `isDirty` only after a successful save, so a refused edit stays dirty and can be retried.
- **Acceptance, the enumeration pin:** a census over every metadata write call site under `packages/app-shell/src/views/` (`createRuntimeMetadata`, `persistRuntimeMetadata`, `publishRuntimeMetadata`, `discardRuntimeDraft` and `dataSource.updateView`). Each site either surfaces a refusal to the user or is ledgered with a reason. A new write site with no row turns the census red.
- **Serial note:** rows 1–3 share `ObjectView.tsx` with PR objectui#11582 (objectui#11578) and with objectui#11581 (`pm:blocked`, `Blocked-by: #11578`).

## Dedupe
- MCP semantic search, repo-scoped: "view config panel save refused silent, persist view config failure only console.error, publish draft failed no toast, report auto-save failed silent" returned objectui#11578 (the first occurrence, above), then #10210, #11204, #7345, #4373, #4211 and #4463, all closed and none about these catches.
- Dedupe words: `view config save refused silent` · `Failed to persist view config console.error only` · `ViewConfigPanel edit save no toast` · `RuntimeDraftBar Publish failed silent` · `ReportView Auto-save failed console.warn` · `Failed to pin view no toast`.
